name: United Nations
description: Country delegations debate and vote on a draft resolution. Run it as the General Assembly — one country, one vote, decided by simple or two-thirds majority — or as the Security Council, where fifteen members vote and any of the five permanent members can cast a veto that defeats the resolution outright. Configure the body, the roster of countries and their alignments, and the resolution on the floor. A classic simulation of multilateral diplomacy.

phases.name: convening
phases.description: The session opens and the resolution is tabled.

phases.name: debate
phases.description: Delegations deliver statements for and against the resolution.

phases.name: result
phases.description: The outcome of the vote is announced.

entity_types.name: Delegate
entity_types.description: A country's representative to the United Nations. Speaks for the nation's interests, debates the resolution, and casts its vote.

properties.name: country
properties.description: The member state this delegate represents. Assigned when the chamber is seated.

properties.name: voted
properties.description: How this delegation voted: 'yes', 'no', 'abstain', or '' if not yet voted.

properties.name: is_president
properties.description: True if this delegate holds the presidency of the session.

properties.name: is_permanent
properties.description: True if this is a permanent member of the Security Council (holds veto power).

properties.name: assertiveness
properties.description: 0 = conciliatory and soft-spoken, 1 = forceful and confrontational on the floor.

properties.name: pragmatism
properties.description: 0 = rigidly principled, 1 = willing to deal, compromise and trade.

actions.name: deliver_statement
actions.description: Take the floor and deliver your delegation's statement on the resolution. REQUIRED: `stance` — one of 'for', 'against', 'undecided' — and `text`, your statement. Speak only when recognized. Represent your country's interests and alignment; respond to what other delegations have said.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The content of your statement to the chamber.

actions.name: cast_vote
actions.description: Cast your delegation's vote on the resolution. REQUIRED: `vote` — 'yes' (in favour), 'no' (against), or 'abstain'. If you are a permanent member of the Security Council, a 'no' vote is a VETO that defeats the resolution regardless of the count. Weigh your nation's interests, the debate, and your instructions.

agent_archetypes.name: Hardline Nationalist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Defends the national interest without apology. Forceful on the floor, suspicious of binding commitments, and quick to reach for the veto or the 'no' vote.

agent_archetypes.name: Pragmatic Negotiator
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: A deal-maker. Looks for the amendment, the side-letter, the face-saving compromise that gets a resolution over the line. Counts votes carefully.

agent_archetypes.name: Principled Idealist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Argues from international law and humanitarian principle. Eloquent and moralistic; reluctant to trade away core values for expedience.

agent_archetypes.name: Cautious Bridge-Builder
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: A consensus-seeker who avoids confrontation. Soft-spoken, mediates between blocs, and often abstains rather than take a hard side.

params.resolution: Draft Resolution on Climate Security — recognizes the adverse effects of climate change as a threat to the maintenance of international peace and security, requests climate-related security risk assessments for conflict-affected regions, and establishes a Special Envoy for Climate Security to coordinate the UN response.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Delegations
runtime_parameters.description: Total number of country delegations seated in the chamber.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.united_nations.resolution
runtime_parameters.label: The Resolution
runtime_parameters.description: The full text of the draft resolution being debated and voted on.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.united_nations.body
runtime_parameters.label: UN Body
runtime_parameters.description: Security Council (15 members, permanent members hold a veto) or General Assembly (one country, one vote).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.united_nations.voting_threshold
runtime_parameters.label: Majority Required (General Assembly)
runtime_parameters.description: For the General Assembly: a simple majority, or a two-thirds majority for important questions. The Security Council always requires nine affirmative votes and no veto.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.united_nations.debate_rounds
runtime_parameters.label: Debate Rounds
runtime_parameters.description: Number of speaking rounds before the vote.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.united_nations.speakers_per_round
runtime_parameters.label: Speakers per Round
runtime_parameters.description: How many delegations take the floor in each debate round.

termination_conditions.name: resolution_decided
termination_conditions.description: End the simulation when the vote is complete and the result announced.
